crossRefs.note: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

translations.web: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
translations.bsb: The east side of the courtyard, toward the sunrise, is to be fifty cubits wide.
translations.kjv: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
translations.asv: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
